definitions.explanation: Used to describe things that form a contrast or are being compared with each other.

examples.japanese: {二|ふた}つの{作品|さくひん}は{対比的|たいひてき}だ。
{対比的|たいひてき}な{色|いろ}を{使|つか}うと{効果的|こうかてき}だ。
{彼|かれ}の{意見|いけん}は{私|わたし}のと{対比的|たいひてき}な{立場|たちば}にある。
examples.english: His opinion stands in contrast to mine.

examples.japanese: {都市|とし}と{農村|のうそん}の{生活|せいかつ}を{対比的|たいひてき}に{描|えが}いた{小説|しょうせつ}だ。
examples.english: It's a novel that depicts urban and rural life in contrast.

notes:
A na-adjective formed from {対比|たいひ} (contrast/comparison) with the {的|てき} suffix. Used in academic, artistic, and formal discussion to describe things placed in contrast or juxtaposition.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {対比的|たいひてき}に{描|えが}く: to depict in contrast
- {対比的|たいひてき}な{表現|ひょうげん}: contrasting expression
- {対比的|たいひてき}な{関係|かんけい}: contrastive relationship

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {対照的|たいしょうてき}: contrastive — very close synonym, more commonly used in everyday language
- {比較的|ひかくてき}: comparatively/relatively — used as an adverb meaning "relatively"
- {対比|たいひ}: contrast/comparison — the base noun
